explanation: The original RTL wrote to the internal memory on `s_valid` alone, which allowed data to be captured even when `s_ready` was low (queue full and no pop). This corrupted the head data and violated the lossless, non-bypassing contract. The fix changes the memory write condition to `push` (i.e., `s_valid && s_ready`), ensuring data is only stored when the source is ready and the queue accepts it.
